candidate.title: Embed source hash includes localized footer, causing false-positive content changes on locale/footer updates
reports: app/models/topicembed.rb:16 — hashing after appending the localized footer couples source-change detection to presentation text, so footer or locale changes trigger needless post revisions

sha1 is computed over the locale-translated footer, so changing site locale marks every previously imported topic as changed and triggers a spurious revision of every post (app/models/topicembed.rb:12)
